data.one_liner: Annotations for widgetbook_generator to build Flutter widgets in isolation.
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations used alongside widgetbook_generator to define use-cases and configure components for Widgetbook. It is part of the tooling used for developing UI components in isolation.
use_when: You are setting up Widgetbook for component development in Flutter
You use widgetbook_generator to automatically generate your Widgetbook app structure
avoid_when: You are not using Widgetbook or code generation for your UI components
You are looking for state management or runtime UI packages
strengths: Simplifies Widgetbook setup with declarative annotations
Integrates seamlessly with build_runner and widgetbook_generator
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation steps
Provides only annotations; requires the companion generator and core packages to function
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml alongside build_runner and widgetbook_generator.
